briefings.006: The giant creatures appear to be evolving. This new breed can operate at night and advances around the clock. They have entered the city after midnight. Eliminate them.
briefings.007: Our worst fears have come true. An Invader mothership has appeared over Britain. The Invaders have returned to Earth. They may have been controlling the growth of the giant creatures. Head there at once and support the British forces.
briefings.010: The Invaders have dropped giant creatures into the city. They appear to be a new species. The creatures are roaming the streets. Deploy immediately.
briefings.013: Emergency. Solas has appeared. This alien creature reduced several cities to ruins in the last war. Head there immediately.
briefings.017: The giant creatures are still breeding underground. Waves of them have devastated the city. We can only eradicate them by destroying their nest. The EDF will re-enter the nest despite the danger. Expect heavy fighting and prepare accordingly.
briefings.020: We have named the tower in the city Insect Hill. It appears to be a nest for the flying insects. We cannot leave it standing. The EDF will demolish Insect Hill to stop the giant creatures from multiplying.
briefings.021: Insect Hill is down, but the giant creatures are still multiplying. The underground nest appears to be the source. Entrances have been found in the city. Giant creatures are pouring out. Destroy the openings to slow the swarm and protect Tokyo.
briefings.023: A huge swarm of red insects is moving over the water. Intercept them on the coast and eliminate them. They are tougher than the black insects and have harder shells.
briefings.024: Destroy the enemy walking tanks in the mountain gorge. There are only a few. Take them all out.
briefings.025: Giant creatures have overrun the city. We are moving to take it back. Several entrances to the underground nest have been found in the area. Destroy them to curb the infestation.
briefings.033: The enemy is preparing an all-out attack. A large force is gathering in the ruined city. Strike before they can launch their assault. It is a dangerous operation, but success would deal a heavy blow. Good luck.
briefings.035: The mothership is down and the Invaders have been defeated. Only the remaining giant creatures stand between us and the end of the war. Eliminate the swarm gathering in the mountains.
briefings.036: This is a cleanup operation. Eliminate all the giant creatures that fled into the city. This is the EDF's final battle.
briefings.038: The floating city in orbit is dropping combat robots worldwide. Their attack has brought civilization to the brink of collapse. Radar contact! Something is falling from above. A meteorite, or something else? Stay alert.
briefings.041: Enemy robots have entered a residential district. Reports say they are destroying buildings and shooting civilians. Deploy immediately, engage the enemy, and help evacuate the residents.
briefings.044: Large saucers are dropping new ground weapons. Reports describe combat robots capable of moving at high speed.
briefings.046: Enemy robots have entered the gorge. The narrow terrain should slow them down. Eliminate them there.
briefings.047: An immense swarm has appeared, as if drawn by the floating city. If it advances, the remaining urban districts will be swallowed up. Eliminate the swarm at all costs.
briefings.048: The swarm has rebuilt Insect Hill. The creatures will soon multiply beyond our control. Destroy the nest again. Scouts report saucers circling nearby, apparently guarding it.
briefings.050: The giant creatures appear to have resumed breeding underground since the floating city arrived. An enormous swarm has suddenly entered the city after midnight. Deploy at once.
briefings.051: An army of spherical combat machines is advancing. The force sent to stop them was literally crushed. Find a way to halt the advance.
briefings.054: We are going underground again to stop the giant creatures from multiplying. Descend the vertical shaft. Many creatures appear to be waiting at the bottom. Proceed with caution.
briefings.055: We have reached the underground tunnels. The advance team encountered giant creatures. It appears to be an ambush. Stay alert.
briefings.056: We have reached the deepest part of the nest. There are relatively few creatures here. This is our chance to wipe them out. Eliminate every creature to complete the operation.
briefings.057: We burned out the nest, but radar has picked up a new contact. Something is rising from deep underground. It may be the many-legged alien we encountered before. Deploy immediately.
briefings.058: A scout team investigating the underground tunnels has been attacked by spherical combat machines. Rush to the area and destroy them.
briefings.059: A squadron of enemy robots has entered the city. They differ slightly in size from the units we have seen before. They may be customized models. Proceed with caution.
briefings.060: The Invaders continue to drop giant creatures. Some appear to be larger variants of the species we have already encountered. Head there immediately.
briefings.061: The Invaders have begun bombing cities across the globe. Several are already lost. A formation is approaching this area. These saucers are dedicated bombers. Keep them from getting directly above you.
briefings.062: The air raids are intensifying. A formation with heavy bombers is approaching. Their firepower is devastating. Keep the heavy bombers in sight and avoid being caught directly beneath them.
briefings.063: Giant creatures have appeared in the city after midnight. Eliminate them.
briefings.064: A major enemy force is advancing on Tokyo. The situation is deteriorating, but survivors are still fighting around the world. We cannot let our allies down. Hold the line. This is the turning point.
briefings.065: Giant creatures are building a nest above ground. Unidentified egg-like objects have been spotted. The creatures may be evolving again. Destroy them before they can spread.
briefings.066: The combat cyborg that burned Shanghai in the last war has returned. It is over 40 meters long. Deploy immediately and intercept it.
briefings.067: Four nest entrances have been found in the city. The advance team was wiped out in seconds. There may be a particularly powerful creature in the area. Stay alert.
briefings.068: Elite saucers are circling the ruined city as if challenging us to a fight. They are escorted by ships with shields that reverse incoming projectiles. Proceed with caution.
briefings.069: Giant creatures around Tokyo are converging on one spot as if being guided. They cover the ground. Destroy the swarm before it overwhelms Japan.
briefings.070: Attacks are intensifying worldwide, and humanity's forces are nearly gone. The Invaders have sent an army of colossal creatures against the resistance in Japan. Creatures as long as 40 meters have entered the city.
briefings.071: Giant creatures are massing in the mountains. Begin the extermination operation. The force that attacked ahead of us was wiped out. There may be a particularly powerful creature among them.
briefings.072: We destroyed the army of colossal creatures, but two more are approaching. They resemble Solas, yet are only about 10 meters long. Destroy both of the smaller Solas.
briefings.073: The floating city's Genocide Cannon has razed cities around the globe. Only Japan remains. The Invaders are assembling their entire force here. Strike and inflict as much damage as you can. The odds are hopeless. Participation is voluntary.
briefings.074: The fighting continues. We retreated to the coast, but enemy robots are pursuing us. The Invaders have committed every giant creature to finishing us here.
briefings.075: We destroyed the Invaders' main force, but units from around the world are arriving. Their entire army surrounds us. Escape is unlikely. Civilization has fallen and the EDF's duty may be over, but we will fight to the end.
briefings.076: We broke through and counterattacked, but the Invaders have surrounded us again. We are losing the strength to fight. Thank you for everything you have done. Even if the world ends, the EDF will fight as long as we stand.
briefings.077: We broke through the encirclement and will keep resisting. The enemy still has a final weapon: its strongest giant creatures. They all appear to be heading here.
briefings.078: The floating city has appeared overhead to crush the remaining resistance. We have nowhere left to retreat. Our survival has already defied the Invaders' plans. The EDF will fight one last battle.
briefings.079: City 1. Spherical enemies: 1 idle, 2 idle, 30 in combat.
